title: Shevna, a man of Jerusalem
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Shabbat 12b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.12b.1), and [Rashi explained](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Shabbat.12b.1.2) that he was a great man.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara names Shevna without a title. Rashi calls him a great man in Jerusalem. See also [Heilprin’s entry, which discusses the possible identifications](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3272&lang=en).
